0022600001.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, and this is Boston's first game of the year as the away team. Boston's Devin Carter is out with an illness, and Detroit's Taurean Prince is day-to-day with a personal reason and is a game-time decision. In 2025-26 the Celtics lost the season series 1-3, including a 104-103 loss in Detroit on January 19, 2026.
